summary: Lloyds Banking Group filed a Form 6-K announcing the purchase of 5,000,000 ordinary shares at a volume-weighted average price of 103.0013 pence per share, under an existing buyback programme authorized on 29 January 2026. The shares were bought from Goldman Sachs International and will be cancelled. This is a routine open-market repurchase made under a pre-existing share buyback programme, not a self-tender offer or issuer tender offer. No special-situation transformation is present. The filing is a standard capital-return disclosure by a foreign private issuer and does not constitute a special situation.
